title: India’s core industries output grows 10.9% in October, led by iron ore, coal and electricity
dek: India's core industries output grew 10.9% in October, led by iron ore, coal and electricity, according to DD India.
summary: DD India reports that India's core industries output grew 10.9% in October, led by iron ore, coal and electricity. No excerpt was provided, so the headline does not give the steel sector's own growth figure or the comparison base.
keyFacts: Core industries output grew 10.9% in October
Growth was led by iron ore, coal and electricity
whyItMatters: Strong iron ore and coal output points to firm raw-material availability for Indian steelmakers, and core-sector data are a widely watched indicator of industrial demand.
implications: Steel producers and raw-material buyers may read the figure as supportive of domestic supply conditions; readers should await the detailed release for steel's own performance.
